title: Settings
description: Interface language, editor, shortcuts, decks and generation models.

account.title: Account
account.managed: The administrator changes your name and email under Users.

password.title: Password
password.failed: Could not change the password. Try again.
password.passwordShort: The new password needs at least 8 characters.
password.passwordLong: The new password is at most 200 characters.

editor.title: Editor
editor.description: Changes apply right away — an open editor updates as you go.

rail.title: Toolbar
rail.keepToolHint: To insert several shapes in a row. Otherwise the cursor goes back to select, as in Figma.

bar.title: Bar above the object

modeHint.object: Properties of the selected object, right above it.
modeHint.off: Properties only in the Design panel on the right.
modeHint.pinned: The bar stays centered above the canvas and doesn’t cover nearby objects.

bar.itemsHint: Buttons you turn off move to the bar’s “⋯” menu.

canvas.title: Canvas
canvas.snapHint: To nearby objects and slide edges. Hold Ctrl while dragging to turn it off for the moment.

wheelHint.pan: The wheel moves the slide, Ctrl+wheel zooms.
wheelHint.zoom: The wheel zooms, Shift+wheel moves the slide.

canvas.largeNudgeHint: {steps, plural, one {Shift+arrow moves by # template grid step.} other {Shift+arrow moves by # template grid steps.}}

template.title: Template
template.lockHint: Template backgrounds and decor can’t be moved by accident. Applies to decks you open afterwards.

shortcuts.title: Shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Click a shortcut and press a new one. A shortcut already in use moves to this command, and the other one becomes unassigned.

problems.needs-modifier: Use Ctrl or Alt: without them the key types text.
problems.reserved: The browser keeps this shortcut for itself.
problems.modifier: Press a key, not just a modifier.

decks.title: Decks
decks.description: Where the new deck composer and the export dialog start. You can still change everything for a single deck.

generation.title: Generation
generation.slideCountHint: Auto — as many as the material needs.

nameHint.title: The file is named after the deck.
nameHint.title-date: The date goes after the title: “Report 2026-09-26”.

models.title: Models
models.description: Generation runs on servers with an OpenAI-compatible API — on this machine, on your local network or in the cloud. Connect a server and assign its models to roles.
models.actionFailed: That didn’t work. Please try again.

connections.title: Connections
connections.emptyBody: Add the server your models run on: Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM or any other with an OpenAI-compatible API.

status.ok: {count, plural, =0 {Checked · no models} one {Checked · # model} other {Checked · # models}}

delete.title: Delete connection?
delete.roles: {count, plural, one {The {roles} role will become unassigned.} other {The {roles} roles will become unassigned.}}

connections.managedHint: Set at installation in the server .env: it can only be checked here.
connections.sharedHint: Set up by an administrator: everyone can use its models, only an administrator changes it.

models.hint: A model you switch off disappears from the picker for everyone who uses this connection, and a run with it will not start. Until you switch one off, any model is available, including new ones the server adds.
models.readOnly: The list is set by whoever can change this connection. Here you can only look at it.
models.unchecked: Check the connection first — its models will show up here.
models.summaryAll: {count, plural, one {# model on} other {All # models on}}, new ones too

errors.notFound: server responded 404 — the address may be missing /v1
errors.invalidResponse: response is not in OpenAI format
errors.blocked: the address points into a private network, which the server does not allow (MODEL_ALLOW_PRIVATE_HOSTS)

baseUrl.label: API address
baseUrl.hint: The address as the app server sees it: localhost is the machine the server runs on.

apiKey.label: API key
apiKey.hint: Local servers usually don’t need a key. The key is stored encrypted on the server and never sent back to the browser.

name.tooLong: The name is longer than {max} characters.

baseUrl.invalid: This doesn’t look like a server address.
baseUrl.protocol: The address starts with http:// or https://.
baseUrl.credentials: Don’t put a login and password in the address — enter the key in the field below.

apiKey.tooLong: The key is longer than {max} characters.
apiKey.whitespace: The key contains a space or line break — make sure you copied all of it and nothing else.

form.checkOk: {count, plural, =0 {The server responded, but it has no models.} one {The server responded: # model.} other {The server responded: # models.}}
form.gone: This connection no longer exists — it was deleted.
form.keysUnavailable: The key cannot be saved: the server has no MODEL_KEYS_SECRET to encrypt keys with. Run lct onboard or set it in .env.

shared.label: Available to every user
shared.hint: Every account sees the models of this connection; only administrators see its address and key.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: Which model performs each step of generation. Models come from the connection’s last check; you can also type a model id.
roles.missing: {count, plural, one {# required role is not assigned — generation won’t start without it.} other {# required roles are not assigned — generation won’t start without them.}}

picker.label: Model for the “{role}” role
picker.off: This model is switched off in the connection settings: a run with it will not start

assistant.name: Assistant
assistant.description: Runs the chat: answers, proposes a deck plan and starts the build. Without a model of its own it talks with the writer’s.

planner.name: Planner
planner.description: Plans the deck: what each slide is about and what type it is.

writer.name: Writer
writer.description: Writes slide text and shortens it when it doesn’t fit the layout.

critic.name: Critic
critic.description: Checks the deck’s content against the audit rules and phrases fixes.

vision.name: Visual review
vision.description: Looks at rendered slides: composition, legibility, consistency with the style.
vision.hint: Needs a model that understands images (VLM).

image.name: Illustrator
image.description: Draws illustrations when the materials have none.
image.hint: Needs a text-to-image model with an OpenAI-compatible images API.

roles.descriptionShared: You are an administrator: these roles are the defaults for every user. Only shared connections are offered here; anyone can pick their own.
roles.inherited: Default for everyone — pick a model to use your own.

users.title: Users
users.description: There is no sign-up: the administrator creates accounts. A switched-off person cannot sign in and keeps their presentations; deleting erases their presentations, chats and private templates.
users.issued: Password for {email}. It is shown once — pass it on; it can be changed under Account.
users.deleteBody: {email} will be deleted with their presentations, chats, projects and private templates. Shared templates stay. This cannot be undone. If the person is only away, switch the account off instead.

errors.exists: An account with this email already exists.
errors.failed: That did not work. Try again.
